items.html: And when the moon complained, she was diminished from the above measure and returned to be as at first, in the aspect of the greatest diminution possible, which is that her ten Sefirot returned and ascended and departed into their roots in the ten Sefirot of ZA, for from there they came out, as above; and nothing remained but her Malchut, which is a single point included of ten, under the back of the Yesod of ZA.
